January 16, 1971
2014-11-27T00:00:44+06:00 | The Daily Star
https://www.thedailystar.net/january-16-1971-53729

The government announced that President Yahya Khan will reach Larkana from karachi on a two-day visit. He will fly to Mahenjodaro at 11:00am and head for the Larkan residence of ZA Bhutto from there for a meeting. It is not possible to contact Bhutto. PPP sources say he is busy with something urgent. But later, he tells journalists that he had nothing to say about tomorrow.
